name: boolean_logic
description: Evaluate short Python Boolean expressions; matched control reads a Boolean literal from the same expression.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.choice([True,False]);b=random.choice([True,False]);op=random.choice(['and','or']);neg=random.choice([True,False]);expr=('not ' if neg else '')+f'({a} {op} {b})';ans=eval(expr,{'__builtins__':{}})
 items.append({'prompt':f'Python expression: {expr}\nIts Boolean value is', 'answer':' '+str(ans)})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Python expression: {expr}\nIts first Boolean literal is', 'answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
